title: P0 F5 · bird/scan secrets/license/tenant-setup/agents guards
goal: Add verified staff-session + role guards to previously-unauthenticated F5 routes: bird/send, bird/config POST, scan/config POST, scan/process POST, agents/run, agents/status, agents/approvals, tenant/setup, license GET/POST. Secret writes + license changes emit audit. Suggestion_only; no auto merge/deploy.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unauthenticated F5 routes return 401 (bird/send, secret writes, scan/process, agents run/status/approvals, tenant/setup, license)
Reception rejected from owner/support-only surfaces (secret writes, scan/process, agents/status, license) → 403
Cross-tenant owner on tenant/setup + license → 403 tenant_mismatch
Secret writes (bird/config, scan/config) + license changes emit audit (secrets.updated / license.changed)
Public readiness GETs (bird/config, scan/config) stay 200; vitest covers negative cases; tsc green
